spec.rationale: Current best has weaker KS in zero-order(3428 rows), no-allocation(23732) and high-conditional-stress groups thanV25, while support-sensitive bootstrap corrections yielded only tiny gains. Test whether a small number of high-leverage feature combinations dominates correction coefficients. Weighting can suppress genuine high-risk or minority borrowers and change effective class balance; report weights/event rates and segment errors, no causal or robustness guarantee.
